memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "And to all the beasts of the earth and all the birds in the sky and all the creatures that move along the ground—everything that has the breath of life in it—I give every green plant for food." And it was so. - Gen 1:30 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God's care does not stop with human beings. Here He turns to the animals, the beasts, the birds, and every creature that moves, and provides food for them too. Every living thing that has "the breath of life" receives provision from God's hand. Not one creature is forgotten. The God who feeds humanity also feeds the sparrow and the lion, the smallest insect and the largest beast.

What a picture of God's vast, generous care. His provision reaches to every corner of creation, to creatures who cannot thank Him, who do not even know Him. He gives simply because it is His nature to give. The whole earth is sustained by His open hand.

The Psalms echo this beautifully: the eyes of all look to God, and He gives them their food at the proper time; He opens His hand and satisfies the desires of every living thing (Ps 145:15-16). Nothing lives outside the reach of His care.

This deepens our trust. If God feeds every creature on earth, creatures who never worry and never pray, how much more will He care for you, His own child, made in His image? Jesus made exactly this point to calm our fears (Mt 6:26). Whatever your need today, look to the God whose provision fills the whole earth. His hand is open, and His care reaches even to you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does it strengthen your faith to see how God provides for every living creature?
2. What need can you bring to the God whose care reaches the whole earth?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You provide for every creature that breathes. Thank You that Your care reaches even to me. Help me trust Your open, generous hand for all I need. Amen.
